prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: character turnaround / 3D modeling reference sheet for RuneNexus.
Input image 1 is the SINGLE APPROVED CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE, the unarmed candidate 16 "Relic Marshal" (유적 감시대장). The user selected THIS exact design, not the round cute tank from other images. Create a polished high-resolution landscape FIVE-VIEW turnaround of the SAME approved stone boss with consistent anatomy, geometry, materials and proportions. This is a reference sheet, not a redesign.
Layout: clean 3-by-2 arrangement: top row FRONT, SIDE, BACK; bottom row TOP and 3/4 with generous equal spacing. Fill the bottom row sensibly with the two views. Exact simple labels beneath each view: "FRONT", "SIDE", "BACK", "TOP", "3/4". No other text, numbers, dimensions, arrows, or watermark. Dark desaturated navy uniform background, no decorative borders. Soft neutral studio lighting with readable depth and little bloom. Full subject silhouettes inside each panel without cropping or overlap, including BOTH empty hands and feet.
View specification: FRONT is directly frontal, level ORTHOGRAPHIC; SIDE is a true 90-degree profile showing real chest/shoulder/hip depth, not a turned three-quarter view; BACK is directly rear ORTHOGRAPHIC; TOP is a TRUE 90-degree vertical downward orthographic view, showing head top, depth of the paired shoulders/chest/back, arms and feet plan, not a steep frontal view; 3/4 is the original approved viewing direction. Use identical neutral standing pose, same limb lengths, shoulder width, head scale, chest volume and part arrangement across all five views. FRONT, SIDE, BACK and 3/4 have equal scale and aligned sole/head levels; TOP is shown with the same relative body dimensions as a plan view.
Identity invariants from the image: small broad BEVELED RECTANGULAR stone head, flat top, heavy angular brow, two deep narrow red slit eyes, straight short stern mouth seam, thick angular jaw, recessed square-spiral red forehead rune. Head sits low inside rocky neck/upper torso, not a round ball or smiling baby face. Preserve massive paired angular stepped stone shoulders, EACH with its existing thick aged bronze strap/frame with square rivets and a single recessed red square-spiral rune on the outward/front-facing rectangular stone shoulder slab. Preserve inward small stone collar chunks, wide irregular divided stone chest framing ONE round ruby-red spherical chest core with the segmented aged bronze ring, and lower stacked stone abdomen. Keep the short thick waist belt and vertical square-riveted aged bronze plate in front of the stone pelvis. Preserve substantial irregular stone upper arms, massive forearms with narrow aged bronze wrist straps, huge empty relaxed stone fists, chunky thighs and shins, dark recessed mechanical hinge connections and broad segmented heavy stone feet. Restrained ruby-red eye/rune/core accents only; neutral warm-gray/tan weathered stone, muted aged bronze and dark iron joints. No overall red tint, no new colored magic.
For unseen back surfaces infer the simplest physically coherent continuation of the SAME front design: chunky broad stone back and rear pelvis, logical rear faces of existing shoulders and wrapping bronze straps, matching dark recessed joints. Do not invent backpack, rear chest orb, spikes, wing shapes, weapons or extra rune panels. Existing paired stone blocks and metal straps must occupy the same 3D positions from every angle; do not paste frontal runes or frontal core onto the back or impossible side locations. Keep recognizable worn broad chips and irregular stone surface relief rather than smooth toys.
Critical prohibitions: NO weapon, spear, axe, sword, hammer, shield or held prop in ANY view; no extra arms, hands or fingers; no chest redesign, narrower lighter physique, cute round head, new armor set, crown, cape, chains, attack stance, scene elements or particles. Do not include other candidate designs or a smaller comparison character. The final sheet must read as five views of one coherent modeled asset, suitable for sculpting the approved boss.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a five-view turnaround sheet. Input image 2 is the APPROVED ORIGINAL CHARACTER for identity reference only.
Fix ONLY two localized reference-sheet errors. Preserve FRONT, BACK, 3/4 and their labels, the overall panel layout, background, materials, and this unarmed boss's exact design and pose.
1) Replace ONLY the lower-left "TOP" subject with a TRUE VERTICAL OVERHEAD ORTHOGRAPHIC PLAN VIEW of exactly the same boss and standing pose. Camera exactly above the head looking straight vertically down, ninety degrees to the floor, with NO forward tilt at all. The top plane of the rectangular stone head must dominate, head front is the LOWER edge of the head footprint. The forehead rune and red eye slots must NOT be presented face-on; chest core and entire front chest/abdomen planes must NOT be presented face-on. Instead show actual footprints and depth: two chunky shoulder top slabs with wrapping bronze straps left/right, top of head centered between shoulders, thick chest/back footprint, hanging arms and hands beside torso, and stone feet/toes projecting forward as seen from above. Rear of character is image-up; face/toes toward image-down. This must clearly be a plan view, NOT the previous bird's-eye FRONT view, not foreshortened standing FRONT. Keep the original boss's broad shoulder width, chunky head, torso depth, huge hands, narrow hip belt, limb structure and no weapons. Full projected silhouette contained in this panel and labels untouched.
2) In ONLY the upper-middle SIDE panel, remove the extra duplicate red square-spiral rune(s) on the near shoulder. This character has exactly ONE red square-spiral rune PER shoulder, placed on the same large rectangular outward/front-facing stone slab visible in original image 2 and in image 1 FRONT/3/4. In SIDE show only the part of that SINGLE rune plane that would physically be visible at 90 degrees; any adjacent side-facing stone face stays plain stone. Do not stamp red runes on adjacent shoulder faces. Keep bronze strap, rivets, armor stone geometry and remaining single rune in the physically corresponding location.
All other pixels should remain as close as possible to image 1. No redesign, no additional subject, text, props, weapons, crown, chains, new armor, background, label change or new effects. Maintain the same high-quality weathered warm-gray stone, aged bronze and restrained ruby-red accents. Output the complete corrected five-view sheet.
